safety.can.title: What ShelfyGAI Can Do
safety.can.body: ShelfyGAI can hide ordinary top-level application windows from the taskbar and Alt+Tab by changing reversible Windows extended styles. The apps keep running in memory and can be restored from ShelfyGAI.
safety.cannot.title: What ShelfyGAI Cannot Do
safety.cannot.body: ShelfyGAI does not terminate apps, suspend processes, bypass Windows permissions, manage secure desktop prompts, or force unsupported windows to behave like normal taskbar apps.
safety.why.title: Why Some Windows Cannot Be Managed
safety.why.body: Windows shell surfaces, the taskbar, Start Menu, ShelfyGAI itself, protected system windows, owned utility windows, tool windows, and elevated apps from a non-elevated ShelfyGAI instance are blocked to keep the desktop recoverable.
safety.restore.title: How To Restore Safely
safety.restore.body: Use Restore or Restore All from the Hidden windows page or tray menu. If an app closed while hidden, ShelfyGAI removes the stale entry safely. Keep restore-on-exit enabled for the safest shutdown behavior.
recovery.description: ShelfyGAI found a recovery file from a previous session. It will restore still-existing hidden windows and safely ignore stale entries.

onboarding.step.what.title: What ShelfyGAI does
onboarding.step.what.body: ShelfyGAI helps keep a busy Windows desktop calm. Choose a window, hide it from the workspace, pin it above others, or group it for later.
onboarding.step.what.visual:
Open windows
Choose action
Stay focused
onboarding.step.hidden.title: Hidden windows
onboarding.step.hidden.body: Hidden windows keep running. ShelfyGAI can remove them from the taskbar and Alt+Tab, then restore them when you need them again.
onboarding.step.hidden.visual:
Hide window
Keep app running
Restore anytime
onboarding.step.overlay.title: Overlay groups
onboarding.step.overlay.body: Overlay groups are ShelfyGAI-owned markers and a compact hub. They work like safe taskbar companions without modifying Windows Explorer.
onboarding.step.overlay.visual:
Group windows
Open compact hub
Restore one or all
onboarding.step.pinned.title: Pinned windows
onboarding.step.pinned.body: Pin means always on top. It keeps important windows visible and can be undone at any time. Pinned windows are unpinned on exit by default.
onboarding.step.pinned.visual:
Pin
Always on top
Unpin safely
onboarding.step.safety.title: Safety and limitations
onboarding.step.safety.body: ShelfyGAI is local-only and reversible. Some apps, tray icons, or elevated windows may not support every behavior, so restore and reset actions stay close by.
